name: glitch-rgb-split
title: Glitch RGB Split
description: Horizontal chromatic aberration split separating red and cyan video color channels.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Passive Rgb Aberration: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
